summary: Iteration 6 - Frontend-only testing of PhotoEnhancer auto-enhancement feature on /merchant/discount. Registered a fresh merchant to avoid locked seed. All 8 requested checks PASSED: (1) upload button visible with correct copy 'Carica una foto · JPG o PNG · L'app la ottimizzerà automaticamente', (2) preview appears <3s after set_input_files on hidden #disc-photo-input, (3) badge visible with exact text 'Foto ottimizzata automaticamente per la homepage!' and disappears after ~4s, (4) img src starts with 'data:image/jpeg;base64,' (~4.8KB for 800x600 test JPEG - well under 500KB budget), (5) POST /api/merchants/me/discount body.image_url starts with data URL prefix and matches persisted value returned by subsequent GET, (6) change/clear/reprocess buttons all functional (clear restores upload button; reprocess re-runs enhancement and produces new data URL), (7) backend accepted payload (200) with no 413, (8) approval workflow works: status becomes 'pending' after edit+save. Regression: editing without changing photo preserves existing image_url in POST and persists it (status returns to 'pending').

ui_bugs.issue: Local `preview` state initializes from `value` prop only on mount and does not sync when parent later updates `value` (e.g., after async GET /merchants/me/discount loads existing image_url). Result: returning merchant with an already-saved photo sees the empty 'Carica una foto' upload prompt instead of the existing image preview. Data still persists correctly because form.image_url is preserved in parent state, so submit round-trips fine, but the UX is misleading. Suggested fix: useEffect([value]) that sets preview to value when value changes and preview is empty (or unconditionally).

action_items: Optional: in PhotoEnhancer.jsx add useEffect(() => { if (value && value !== preview) setPreview(value); }, [value]) so existing/persisted image_url shows in preview after parent's async load.
critical_code_review_comments: PhotoEnhancer.jsx: `preview` state is not synced with `value` prop after mount (see UI bug above).
applyConvolution runs a 3x3 kernel in JS on the main thread over up to 1200x1200 = 1.44M pixels; for larger images this can jank the UI. Consider OffscreenCanvas/Worker for future perf.
MerchantDiscount.jsx: no client-side check that image_url is present before submit (feature intentionally optional since backend DiscountIn.image_url is Optional[str]) - fine.
test_credentials: Created ephemeral merchant testmerchant_813531@scontiroma.it / test12345 during run (also 395930 and 933347 from earlier attempts). Recommend cleanup script or ignore (all prefixed 'testmerchant_').
seed_data_creation: Registered fresh merchants via POST /api/auth/register (role=merchant) to bypass locked-for-month seed data. /tmp/testphoto.jpg (800x600 solid brown JPEG, ~8KB) generated with PIL.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PhotoEnhancer works end-to-end. Only outstanding item is the value->preview sync on remount/reload (see ui_bugs). All primary acceptance criteria of iteration 6 verified. Payload size is very small (~5KB) with the tiny test JPEG; real photos will be larger but still well under limits due to 1200px max + JPEG 0.85.
rca of the issue: N/A - no blocking bug. UX sync issue root cause: PhotoEnhancer uses useState(value || null) which captures value only at first render; when parent's load() later populates form.image_url via setState, the child prop updates but the child's local `preview` state is not re-derived.
